## 08 – Postmortem (owner: Tharindu)
Recovery result from 07 + stored context (`GET /api/machine/incidents/:id/context`, **BD-4**) → Groq → validate against `postmortem-output.schema.json` → save (`POST /api/machine/incidents/:id/postmortem`, **BD-4**).

nodes.name: When called by 07 Recovery Check
nodes.notes: Input: recovery result (+ optional rca, incident, timeline).

nodes.name: Sign context request
nodes.notes: Signed GET of the stored incident context (BD-4).

nodes.name: Collect incident context
nodes.notes: Input from 07 wins; the stored context fills what is missing.

nodes.name: Groq: postmortem
nodes.notes: Groq chat completions (OpenAI-compatible). Auth: n8n credential "Groq API" (Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer <key>).

nodes.name: Sign store postmortem request
nodes.notes: Only a valid draft with an incident id is stored.
